of.needed: whether existing ClusterSecretStore objects have been rewritten to v1 storage version

consequence.statement: Existing ClusterSecretStore objects stored as v1beta1 must be rewritten to v1 storage version and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta1 support.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration to rewrite all existing ClusterSecretStore objects and update status.storedVersions to v1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1, requiring a storage version migration to rewrite existing objects before v1beta1 is removed in a later release.
